evidence.observation: Ramp tracked the setpoint within 1 °C; at the start of growth it overshot to 760.5 °C, then settled to 750.0 °C
Power fell from 81% during the ramp to 39-44% at the hold, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping
Steady at about 3.0 Torr with Ar at 100 sccm, so no sign of a leak or blocked exhaust
Purged down to 5-7 ppm and still low
